units.rawText: The vacuum cleaner has been making a strange noise, is it broken?

units.rawText: Guess I'll have to clean with brush and mop if it can't be fixed. Although, the room is quite big. Professor, could you lend me a hand? If you don't, I don't think I'll be able to finish cleaning by the end of the day...
